title: let me know when you will introduce the System Theme device Mode
body: i'm really sad i had to delete this app because i truly like it, unfortunately tho it doesn't automatically updates when i change my phone or desktop on light mode or dark mode. i would have to MANUALLY do it which is the most annoying thing ever and a complete waste of time for me. Let me know when you will introduce this automatic feature and i'll be 100% back.
author: lauraioanaceo
